EMEA-H-C-006139.no-pi-document: no product-information document in the EPAR documents JSON

rule: Forward capture: the EMA medicines JSON, the EPAR documents JSON (for the product-information URL) and the current English product-information PDF of every reference product in sources/eu-products.json, pinned by SHA-256. A PDF whose URL and EPAR last_updated_date equal those of the newest earlier capture is not downloaded again; its pin is carried forward (pi_carried_from). Changes are reported against the newest earlier capture by EMA revision_number, last_updated_date and medicine_status and by PDF SHA-256. Nothing is committed to build/eu.
